response.justification: While this candidate demonstrates strong IC6-level technical leadership and production-scale systems experience, they lack the core domain expertise required for this specialized Principal role in growth/experimentation systems. The resume shows no evidence of experimentation platform building, A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging systems, or metrics/telemetry infrastructure—all central to the position. The role requires deep expertise in a specific domain that would require significant ramp-up.
strengths: Proven IC6/Staff-level technical leadership with 15+ years of production engineering experience across web, mobile, and distributed systems
Strong scale experience managing millions of HTTP requests per second and optimizing complex systems (Dunnhumby, Optilyz)
Consistent ability to design and ship complex systems while maintaining hands-on coding and mentoring (workshops, open source contributions)
concerns: No demonstrated experience building or operating experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, or feature flagging systems
Absence of metrics infrastructure, telemetry, or statistical analysis background essential for growth measurement systems
Resume reflects full-stack generalist background rather than specialized infrastructure/systems engineering focus required for Principal role

key_factors.factor: No Metrics, Telemetry, or Data Analysis Background
Strong IC6-Level Technical Leadership and Production Scale Experience
